verdict.rationale: A downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec is a fair question for a compliance and registered-agent service provider, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no mention of any API or machine-readable spec. Both probes record only access walls: a Cloudflare challenge on www.wolterskluwer.com, and legacy-host redirects into that walled host. So there is no evidence the capability exists, though the walls also mean its absence is unconfirmed.
